_about: One-time corrections to existing lawsuit rows, applied by inc/lawsuit-updates.php when 'version' changes. Each row matches id AND its current case_name; only the listed fields change, add_source_urls is merged into source_urls, move_facility_links moves the case's link from one record to another, and the note is appended to reviewer_notes. New cases in seeds/lawsuits.json are inserted in the same pass. An update may name its case by 'match': {docket, name_contains} instead of id + case_name (only a lone match counts; the replaced values go into the note). 'merge_duplicates' joins second copies of one case (same docket, filing date and court), keeping the row with the full docket number: kop_apply_lawsuit_merges().
